Prybuzhany Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Mykolaiv Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Once known as Kantakuzivka, this village was a center of the Kantikuzva Hasidic dynasty, founded by Gedalya of Linnitz — and the cemetery still holds a memorial marker for the dynasty's founding-line figure Yitzhak Yoel, installed by the organization Ohalei Tzaddikim after locals removed most tombstones in the 1970s for their own use. The Jewish community, historically over 40 percent of the local population, survived an 1897 pogrom that destroyed its property before being executed following the Nazi occupation of August 1941.
